declarations.description:
The mobile tab bar: three to five `c2-bottom-nav-item` destinations along the bottom of the screen, each an icon
over a short label with an optional count or dot badge. It is a navigation landmark (named "Main" unless the host
has an `aria-label`) of plain links or buttons, the current one announced with `aria-current="page"`; not a tab
list, so every item is a normal tab stop.

Set `value` to the value of the item being shown, or mark that item `current`. Activating another item fires a
cancelable `item-select` (cancelling it also stops the link, for an unsaved-changes guard), then updates `value`
and fires `change`. Activating the current item again fires `reselect`, the place to scroll back to the top.

The host is `position: sticky` to the bottom by default, so as the last element of the page it stays on screen
without covering the end of the content, and the bar is padded by `env(safe-area-inset-bottom)` for the home
indicator. With `hide-on-scroll` it slides away while the page scrolls down and returns on scroll up, at the top
or when focus moves into it. Every look (Material indicator, translucent glass, floating dock, top line) is a set
of CSS variables.
declarations.name: BottomNav

members.name: value
members.description: Value of the current item. Empty: the item marked `current` decides, and `value` reads it back.

members.name: labelVisibility
members.description: Which labels show: all (`labeled`), all up to three items and the current one from four (`auto`), the current one (`selected`) or none (`unlabeled`).

members.name: hideOnScroll
members.description: Slides the bar away while the page scrolls down and brings it back on scroll up, at the top or on focus.

members.name: scrollTarget
members.description: Id of the element whose scrolling `hide-on-scroll` follows, looked up in the bar's document or shadow root. Empty: the window.

members.name: scrolledAway
members.description: Whether `hide-on-scroll` has currently moved the bar out of view. Also exposed as `:state(scrolled-away)`.

members.name: adoptMarkedValue
members.description: Without a `value`, the item the author marked `current` provides it.

members.name: assign
members.description:
A server-rendered item hydrates after the bar, and a property written before that would make its first client
render differ from the server's, so wait for its first update.

declarations.description:
One destination of a `c2-bottom-nav`: an icon over a short label, with an optional count or dot badge. With an
`href` it renders a link, otherwise a button. Mark the item of the page being shown `current` (or set the bar's
`value`) to announce `aria-current="page"`, show the indicator behind the icon and swap in the `current-icon`.

The badge is drawn with `c2-badge` and read as part of the item's name ("Inbox, 3 new", "Chat, new activity"),
so a screen reader hears what a sighted user sees. A label hidden by the bar's `label-visibility` stays the name.
declarations.name: BottomNavItem

members.name: value
members.description: Identifies the item for the bar's `value`. Falls back to `href`, then the label.

members.name: target
members.description: Browsing context used when `href` is set, such as `_blank`.

members.name: label
members.description: Label used when the default slot is empty.

members.name: current
members.description: The item of the page being shown: announced as `aria-current="page"`. Set by the bar from its `value`.

members.name: count
members.description: Number shown in a badge on the icon. `0` hides the badge.

members.name: max
members.description: Upper bound for `count`; larger values show as `<max>+`.

members.name: dot
members.description: Shows a dot badge on the icon, read as "new activity". Ignored while `count` is shown.

members.name: labelHidden
members.description: Hides the label visually while keeping it as the accessible name. Set by the bar from `label-visibility`.

members.name: effectiveValue
members.description: The value the bar compares with its own: `value`, else `href`, else the label.
